profile.headline: Senior Software engineer ll at BDI-Bearing Distributors Inc
profile.summary:
- Seasoned hybris Engineer with expertise in Java/J2EE, SAP Commerce Cloud, Hybris , Spartacus, Angular, NgRx, and RxJS. 
- I specialize in building scalable, high-performance e-commerce platforms that deliver exceptional user experiences. 
- Beyond coding, I’m passionate about mentoring teams, promoting best practices, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. I thrive in collaborative environments where innovation and quality drive results.

positions.title: Senior E-commerce Java Developer
positions.description:
- Production support,Deployment and maintenance/enhancement of SAP hybris B2B/B2C commerce application.
- Development of Spartacus/Angular based storefront application.
- worked on integration with UPS Address validation, shipping rates, sales force marketing cloud, SEO, google analytics, google tag manger, cart,order histoy , order details , my account, login, impex, cronjobs, data model, groovy scripting,Flexi search, Smart Edit, CMS, Solr, SAP commerce cloud,
- Hybris upgrade,Composable storefront upgrade,angular version upgrade
- cloudfare CDN , composable storefront OCC layer caching
- working with multiple teams across the organization 
- Mentoring/assisting team members

positions.title: Lead Consultant
positions.description:
- Worked as a Hybris Track Lead. 
- Coordinating with offshore team. 
- Production Support and Maintenance activities of Hybris E-commerce site.
- Analysis of incoming support and maintenance request, root cause analysis
- Coordinating with different teams at onshore like merchandise team, content release team, L3 team, L1.5 team, Prod ops team
